title: Silas and the Colony
author: Rosalind Voss
blurb: Edmund Almeida, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
